title: RFC: Agent Reassignment for AI Eval Framework v2 Ankur
summary: Reassign AI Eval Framework v2 Ankur work to align ownership with delivery domain responsibilities while preserving clear product accountability for outcomes and acceptance criteria.
problem: The current assignment split does not consistently reflect domain ownership boundaries. Product should own measurable outcomes and framing, while engineering should own implementation and evaluation execution workflows. Without explicit reassignment, handoffs and accountability can drift.

reassignment_plan.reason: Defines user value, business outcomes, and measurable acceptance thresholds.
Requires implementation-level data pipeline and quality guard decisions.
Needs technical instrumentation, failure categorization, and reproducible analysis.
Owns build, runtime, observability, and deployment readiness.

acceptance_criteria: OrgX records show the four scoped ownership updates exactly as defined in reassignment_plan.
Product-owned metrics include numeric targets and pass/fail thresholds for the evaluation program.
Engineering-owned scopes include implementation checklists and explicit integration dependencies.
No scoped area has dual-primary ownership after reassignment.
A single verification pass confirms that downstream task execution follows updated owners.

success_metrics.name: Ownership Mapping Accuracy
success_metrics.target: 100% of scoped areas assigned to intended domain owners

success_metrics.name: Metric Completeness
success_metrics.target: 100% of product metrics include numeric target + measurement method

success_metrics.name: Execution Readiness Coverage
success_metrics.target: All engineering scopes contain implementation checklist + dependency list

success_metrics.name: Reassignment Verification SLA
success_metrics.target: Ownership verification completed within 1 working day of update

verification_steps: Open the initiative and task in OrgX, then inspect each scoped area owner domain value.
Confirm Success Criteria & Metrics is owned by product and includes numeric targets.
Confirm the three technical scopes are owned by engineering and include implementation notes.
Capture evidence (screenshots or logs) and mark verification outcome for the milestone.

risks.risk: Residual ambiguity between product metric definition and engineering feasibility.
risks.mitigation: Run a short cross-domain review before finalizing metric thresholds.

risks.risk: Partial reassignment is applied, leaving mixed ownership.
risks.mitigation: Use a single checklist-driven update with explicit before/after validation.

non_goals: Changing initiative scope beyond ownership realignment.
Redefining existing evaluation architecture in this reassignment step.
